hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/SESSION_NOTES.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; start=$(grep -nE "^## Session" "$f" | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); [ -n "$start" ] || exit 0; body=$(tail -n +"$start" "$f"); jq -n --arg c "$body" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Most recent entry from SESSION_NOTES.md (read the full file if you need earlier sessions):\n\n"+$c)}}'
